attempt_prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. One horizontal sprite strip, equal-width cells, full figures, generous cell margin, right-facing, flat magenta #ff00ff background, no text or grid or shadows. ORIGINAL pangolin MICA: jade overlapping scale hood, cream muzzle/belly, white gloves, coral hiking boots, long jade tapered tail. Reference 1 native Sonic provides ONLY phase mechanics, NEVER copy Sonic design; reference 2 MICA concept identity; reference 3 approved pixel style. Broad crisp 16-bit pixel clusters, 32-40px tall enlarged nearest-neighbour, stable identical head and proportions. NEAR leg means camera-side and always overlaps torso/far leg with BRIGHT CORAL boot and lighter jade shin. FAR leg always BEHIND torso and near leg, DARK BURGUNDY boot and dark jade shin. Depth never swaps with screen x position. EXACTLY 8 cells in native script order $0F,$10,$11,$12,$13,$14,$0D,$0E. 1: far boot planted beneath body, near knee bent passing lifted in front. 2: near bright boot swings FORWARD right, far dark boot trails LEFT. 3: near bright boot extended FORWARD RIGHT, far dark boot extended BACK LEFT. 4: near bright boot heel striking FORWARD RIGHT, far dark boot trailing LEFT. 5: near bright boot planted beneath body, far dark leg passes BEHIND. 6: near bright boot pushes BACK LEFT, far dark boot swings FORWARD RIGHT behind. 7: near bright boot extended BACK LEFT, far dark boot extended FORWARD RIGHT behind. 8: near bright boot trailing BACK LEFT, far dark boot heel striking FORWARD RIGHT behind. Never darken the front-right boot in cells 2,3,4; never brighten the front-right boot in cells 6,7,8. Natural counter-swing arms. Treat these numbered instructions as strict exposure-sheet poses.

selection.review: Selected attempt 6 throughout. All eight reduced phases checked individually against the table: bright near boot forward in 01-03, planted in 04, rear in 05-07; dark far boot planted in 00 and forward in 05-07. No leg-layer reversal found. Far passing boot is mostly occluded in 04; narrow native boxes compress the hood/tail. No per-frame regeneration or repainting required.
